title: Nanoliposomal curcumin protects against D-galactose-induced hepatic aging by targeting oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and inflammatory signaling.
publicationName: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
journalName: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
snippet: With advancing age, individuals experience a decline in liver function, an increase in oxidative stress, and diminished mitochondrial efficiency. This research examined the protective effects of curcumin (CUR), in both free and nanoliposomal (CUR-LNP) forms, against D-galactose (D-gal)-induced liver aging in male Wistar rats.
